title: ParseX telemetryReport Payload
description: Kind-specific payload for kind=telemetryReport. Adapts OTLP's JSON span encoding to a single local process: flat span array (no resourceSpans/scopeSpans nesting), camelCase names per CONVENTIONS.md, per-run counter ids starting at 1 (well within the JSON safe-integer range). parentSpanId omitted for root spans (omit-over-null).

spanId.description: Per-run counter id (SpanId), serialized as a JSON number.

parentSpanId.description: Parent span id; omitted entirely for root spans.

startNanos.description: Nanoseconds since the process-local reference point.

durationNanos.description: Derived endNanos - startNanos, included directly since most consumers want it.

attributes.description: String keys to string/number/boolean values (AttributeValue variant).
